paragraphs: R. Levi son of R. Tarfon. R. Yehudah son of R. Simon spoke in his name, Midrash Eikhah, at 'From the daughter of Zion has departed.' Yet a similar account at the end of Aḥarei Mot has ben Perata; so too in Eikhah, at 'Her impurity is in her skirts'; and at 'The adversary has spread his hand': ben Palta.
